title: BrainUsage
description: Brain tokens per day against the ceiling (spec-agent-memory-system.md v1.0 section 9; `GET /brain/usage?days=`), computed from `runs.jsonl` (`brainTokens`) and curation lines. `days` has one entry per calendar day in the requested window, oldest first, zero-filled. `ceiling` is the daily token ceiling the brain runs under (1,000,000 on `claude-credits`, B4), or `null` when the server does not know it.
